g.text: UML - Implemented original-identity recovery and cancellation (WP-23)
Cancellation, or operator inquiry with exact reason + request key
Current ownership / operator role / queue; origin + CSRF
Lock original intent; seal command identity and digest
Accept same command ID; bounded original recovery job
Original request ID and original payment
Recover committed booking / finality receipt first
Repair workflow and command from original receipt
Same intent lock as execution; cancellation already durable
Release exact bound unsubmitted reservation if present
Read exact original work; claim short fenced lease
Commit before transport; defer if existing lease is active
Signed original identity + full original scope
Bounded retry; exhaustion requires owned review
Owned payment case; no expiry release
Recheck lease / fence after locks; immutable receipt
Independently verify evidence; same financial business key
Same settlement journal; cancellation too late
Release submitted hold and daily budget atomically
Canonical financial status + immutable command history
Claim persistent cursor page (50); commit cursor before service work
Read authoritative reservation / hold / booking / daily-use positions
Financial snapshot, including computed aggregate held amount
Compare owning intent, scope, provider work, finality and age
[Orphan / mismatch / submitted age >= synthetic 5 minute threshold]
Stable break ID; append changed observation; durable audit
Idempotent owned case with original financial identity
No financial override or automatic case closure.
Financial result, pending cancellation or owned reconciliation evidence
Recovery never mints another economic payment.
Unknown submitted funds cannot expire into release.
Late cancellation preserves the original settlement.
